task_commit_basis: merge commit of the reference change (code after the optimization landed), from https://github.com/honojs/hono/commit/55039ba19aa9a49fe138dce7b3fe7477e484d303

reference_change.title: perf(context): iterate the header record with for..in

workload.source: written here from the description of https://github.com/honojs/hono/pull/5118 (its query GET /id/1?name=bun and body POST /json cases): 50,000 of each served in process by app.request, with header records passed to c.text and c.json, eval/tasks/workloads/honojs-hono-pr5118-landed/bench.ts bundled with esbuild

oracle.source: hono's own src/context.test.ts and src/hono.test.ts under vitest, with a minimal config (eval/tasks/workloads/honojs-hono-pr5118-landed/vitest.config.mjs); targeted tests only

evidence.note: description, as matched by the miner: speedup claims: 1.00x faster; 1.07x faster; 1.04x faster; 1.01x faster; 1.03x faster | timings: 300.11 ns; 295.27 ns; 302.92 ns; 311.90 ns; 288.84 ns; 298.71 ns; 299.84 ns; 315.35 ns

status_reason: built here and ran workload and oracle on the task and reference trees; see runs. The repository builds with bun, which is not installed here; only esbuild and vitest are installed (npm --before the change's date) and the source is bundled directly. Node is v24 from nvm
